subject: pharmacology
title: GLP 1 Receptor Agonists and Tirzepatide: Exenatide, Liraglutide, Semaglutide

steps.tx: **Exenatide**, synthetic exendin 4 from Gila monster venom, resists DPP 4 beheading and opened the GLP 1 receptor agonist class: glucose dependent insulin secretion, glucagon suppression, slowed gastric emptying and central satiety in one peptide. Twice daily injections before meals taught the class's manners (nausea front loaded, dose escalation over weeks), and its extended release weekly suspension proved patients would trade daily needles for weekly ones when efficacy followed.
steps.say: Exenatide proved a venom peptide could run glucose, stomach and appetite from one receptor.

left.title: GLP 1 agonist actions
points: Glucose dependent insulin secretion
Glucagon suppressed when glucose is high
Gastric emptying slowed, postprandial peaks blunted
Central satiety: intake and weight fall

right.title: Class adverse grammar
points: Nausea and vomiting early, dose escalation mitigates
Gastroparesis and ileus cautions
Pancreatitis warnings debated, counsel symptoms
Gallbladder events and heart rate rise modestly

steps.tx: **Liraglutide**, fatty acid chained to albumin for a 13 hour half life and daily injection, delivered the class's first cardiovascular outcome victory (LEADER: fewer major events and cardiovascular deaths in high risk type 2 diabetes) and a licensed obesity dose above its diabetes dose. Its daily rhythm and outcome pedigree kept it prescribed long after weekly rivals arrived, particularly where cardiovascular indications are written into the choice.
steps.say: Liraglutide made GLP 1 a cardiovascular drug, not only a glucose drug, and proved it daily.

nodes.label: HbA1c and weight fall over months
Cardiovascular outcomes benefit in high risk diabetes

steps.tx: **Semaglutide** stretched the half life to a week (weekly injection) and then abolished the needle for many with an oral daily formulation riding an absorption enhancer on an empty stomach ritual. STEP and SUSTAIN programmes delivered weight losses of 10 to 15 percent and HbA1c falls nearing 2 percent, numbers that reorganised obesity medicine. Retinopathy signals with rapid HbA1c improvement in high risk eyes and dose dependent nausea discipline its escalation.
steps.say: Semaglutide made weekly, then daily oral, GLP 1 therapy powerful enough to rebuild obesity practice.

left.title: Semaglutide forms
points: Weekly subcutaneous: diabetes and obesity doses
Oral daily: empty stomach, small sip, 30 minute fast
Weight loss 10 to 15 percent in obesity trials
Cardiovascular outcome benefit in type 2 diabetes

right.title: Escalation discipline
points: Monthly dose steps against gastrointestinal tolerance
Nausea usually peaks after each increase
Eye review where retinopathy and rapid falls meet
Stop before elective anaesthesia per aspiration guidance

steps.tx: **Tirzepatide** adds GIP receptor agonism to GLP 1 (a twincretin), and the duet outperformed either alone in SURPASS and SURMOUNT programmes: HbA1c falls beyond 2 percent and weight losses approaching 20 percent in obesity trials, resetting what pharmacotherapy may promise before bariatric surgery. Its adverse grammar remains gastrointestinal and dose paced; whether GIP agonism or antagonism is the ideal partner stays mechanistically argued even as outcomes accumulate.
steps.say: Tirzepatide duets GLP 1 with GIP and out loses every predecessor; the stomach still sets the tempo.

nodes.label: Weekly tirzepatide, dual GIP and GLP 1 agonism
Weight loss approaching surgical ranges in trials
Pancreatitis symptoms and gallbladder vigilance counselled

steps.tx: The **GLP 1 agonist** class rules for examinations assemble cleanly: never combine with DPP 4 inhibitors (same axis, no additive gain), expect hypoglycaemia only when insulin or sulfonylureas ride along (reduce those first), warn of nausea and dose pacing, avoid in personal or family medullary thyroid carcinoma or MEN 2 (rodent C cell signal in labelling), and plan perioperative fasting because delayed gastric emptying aspirates.
steps.say: No gliptin partner, reduce the sulfonylurea first, and respect the stomach before every anaesthetic.

left.title: Prescribing rules
points: Never combine with DPP 4 inhibitors
Reduce sulfonylurea or insulin to avert hypoglycaemia
Escalate monthly, counsel nausea honestly
Oral contraceptive absorption: backup advised after dose rises

right.title: Exclusions and alerts
points: Medullary thyroid carcinoma or MEN 2 history
Prior serious pancreatitis: caution and counsel
Severe gastroparesis: avoid
Perioperative aspiration planning with anaesthesia

steps.tx: **Cardiovascular and kidney outcome** trials redrew the diabetes map around this class and the SGLT2 inhibitors next lesson: in type 2 diabetes with established cardiovascular disease or high risk, a GLP 1 agonist with outcome benefit (liraglutide, semaglutide, dulaglutide) is indicated independent of HbA1c, because the events prevented outnumber the glucose points argued. Prescribing by glucose alone after these trials is practising a previous decade's medicine.
steps.say: After the outcome trials, these drugs are prescribed for hearts at any HbA1c the patient happens to have.

left.title: Outcome proven choices
points: Liraglutide, semaglutide, dulaglutide: event reduction
Indication independent of baseline HbA1c
Stroke reduction signals across meta analyses
Weight and pressure dividends accompany

right.title: Choosing against SGLT2 rivals
points: Heart failure and kidney progression: SGLT2 leads
Stroke and weight predominance: GLP 1 argues first
Many patients earn both sequentially
Needle acceptance and cost arbitrate locally

steps.tx: **Obesity pharmacotherapy beyond diabetes** borrows the same agents at higher doses (semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly, tirzepatide obesity dosing, liraglutide 3 mg daily historically), with discontinuation regain as the honest footnote: most weight returns within a year of stopping in follow up studies, reframing obesity as chronic relapsing disease needing maintenance therapy rather than a course of injections. Muscle mass preservation (protein, resistance training) joins the prescription as lean mass shares the losses.
steps.say: Stop the drug and most weight returns; prescribe maintenance and muscle protection, not a course.

nodes.label: Obesity dose GLP 1 therapy started with lifestyle programme
Weight falls over 12 to 18 months to plateau
Maintenance dosing, protein and resistance training
Stopping predicts regain: chronic disease framing

steps.tx: **Practical titration closes the** lesson: start exenatide, liraglutide, semaglutide or tirzepatide at initiation doses that are deliberately subtherapeutic, climb every four weeks as nausea permits, never chase HbA1c faster than the stomach allows, and reduce or hold for intolerable gastrointestinal effects rather than abandoning the class at the first wave. Antiemetic crutches are brief; dose patience is the actual antiemetic.
steps.say: The titration schedule is the treatment; nausea management is calendar management.

left.title: Titration habits
points: Initiation doses are tolerance doses, not therapy
Escalate every 4 weeks as tolerated
Smaller, slower meals reduce nausea
Hold a step rather than abandoning for transient nausea

right.title: Counselling script
points: Nausea peaks days after each increase
Fullness arrives early: stop eating sooner
Vomiting or severe abdominal pain: seek care
Weight and HbA1c judged at maintenance, not initiation
